description: Check email syntax, DNS and MX records, disposable providers, role addresses, free providers and SPF/DMARC presence. Returns likely-deliverable, risky, undeliverable or invalid with reasons. No message is sent and the mail server is not contacted. These are DNS and syntax signals, not proof that a mailbox exists or accepts delivery. Costs $0.002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
